explication: This repository is the official Express.js website and documentation, built with Astro. Readers browse versioned guides and API references, resources, and blog content through localized site navigation; they can also search or ask questions, and retrieve documentation-oriented text and feeds. The graph includes documented product branches visible in the tree, but sampled source was limited, so uncertain page-rendering and indexing connections are omitted.
